review_policy.intent: Player-facing reuse judgement for already-collected POE1 build families. This is not a solved 3.29 tier list.
review_policy.promotion_gate: A family can be practiced from older/staged PoBs, but final 3.29 recommendation still needs 3.29 PoB or launch-week validation.
review_policy.historical_patch_gate: 3.27 and 3.28 build families must pass later official patch notes, minor patches, and hotfix checks before moving above practice/provisional status.

label_legend.label: 가능성 높음
label_legend.meaning: 3.29 patch notes are neutral or favorable enough that the family is worth prioritizing for updated PoB/live validation.

label_legend.label: 연습해도 됨
label_legend.meaning: Core play pattern and leveling muscle memory should transfer, but do not assume exact 3.28 damage/gear numbers survive.

label_legend.label: 손봐야 가능
label_legend.meaning: The family has a direct support, ascendancy, passive, or item pressure change. It may survive, but old PoBs need edits.

label_legend.label: 구경만
label_legend.meaning: New, reshuffled, or under-modeled mechanics. Watch and collect PoBs before practicing seriously.

label_legend.label: 위험 신호
label_legend.meaning: Direct patch-note hit to the build engine or a known required mechanic. Use only as a test case until new evidence lands.

top_takeaways: Non-Spectre minions, especially SRS, Zombies, Dominating Blow, and listed elemental/stone/chaos/lightning golems, are one of the best 3.29 practice targets.
Spectre-only builds need caution because 3.29 lowers the life of several monsters when used as Spectres.
Cold spell DoT/autobomber practice gained value because Cold Snap, Creeping Frost, and Vortex received favorable spell changes.
Totems and mines are not dead, but they are old-PoB-edit lanes because Spell Totem, Ballista Totem, Mine supports, Charged Mines, and Hierophant totem scaling changed.

Archmage spell builds remain worth practicing, but old mana-stack damage expectations must be recalculated because Archmage lost some unreserved-mana scaling while many spells changed cast time and mana cost.
Reliquarian shell ideas are still watchlist, not practice plans, because 3.29 reshuffles Reliquarian notables and Scion now splits into Ascendant, Reliquarian, and Luminary branches.

category_matrix.purpose: 엔드게임 빌드가 달라도 액트/초기 맵에서 공유되는 손 연습과 전환 타이밍을 분리한다.

tracks.label: 캐스터 기본 루트
applies_to: Arc / Rolling Magma / Freezing Pulse / Frost Bomb / Orb of Storms starts
Spark, Shock Nova, Ball Lightning, Ice Nova, Brand, Cold DoT로 넘어가는 루트
patch_hooks: Faster Casting is purchasable by all classes after Sharp and Cruel.
Many self-cast spells received cast-time, damage, crit, or mana-cost changes.
tracks.why: 초반 캐스터 루틴은 거의 모든 주문 빌드에 전이된다. 단, 3.29는 주문별 마나 비용과 계수가 많이 바뀌었으므로 최종 링크는 다시 계산해야 한다.

tracks.label: 레인저 활/투사체 레벨링
patch_hooks: Faster Attacks is purchasable by all classes after The Caged Brute.
Elemental Hit was directly nerfed, while Elemental Hit of the Spectrum is not affected.
Ballista Totem support was nerfed.
tracks.why: 무빙, 조준, 보조 토템 설치, 무기 업그레이드 습관은 쓸모 있다. 다만 힛 기반 Ele Hit/ballista 쪽은 3.29 수치 재계산 전까지 최종 후보로 보지 않는다.
do_not_assume: generic Elemental Hit equals Elemental Hit of the Spectrum

tracks.label: 근접 무기 교체 루트
patch_hooks: Crystalfall introduces a new self-used Slam support lane.
Reflect map modifiers changed into rare-monster thorns that can be mitigated.
tracks.why: 3.29 최종 빌드가 바뀌어도 근접은 무기 DPS 갱신, 방어 플라스크, 보스 붙기/빠지기 연습 가치가 높다.
do_not_assume: old trauma/boneshatter defense is enough for new league mechanic

tracks.label: 마인: Pyroclast -> Exsanguinate/Reap
applies_to: Eye of Winter mine only as a separate side branch
patch_hooks: Blastchain Mine and High-Impact Mine less-damage and cost multipliers changed.
Charged Mines lost some throw-speed/crit value and gained cost pressure.
tracks.why: 던지고 폭파하는 리듬, 보스 선깔기, 캠페인 전환 타이밍은 그대로 연습 가치가 있다. 숫자는 반드시 3.29 PoB로 다시 봐야 한다.
do_not_assume: Hexblast and Exsanguinate are same mine lane

tracks.label: 소환수: Absolution/SRS/Golem 액트 루트
patch_hooks: Non-Spectre minions no longer pause while attacking.
Summoned Raging Spirits and several Golem types are explicit beneficiaries.
Absolution cast time improved.
tracks.why: 3.29에서 가장 연습 가치가 높은 루트 중 하나다. 특히 소환수 위치감, Convocation/Bone Offering 습관, Act 6 전환은 바로 쓸 수 있다.
do_not_assume: Carrion Golem exact DPS without current PoB

tracks.label: 토템: Holy Flame/Spell Totem 루트
patch_hooks: Spell Totem support less-damage penalty increased.
Ritual of Awakening damage per summoned totem was reduced.
Totem mastery and Shaman's Dominion crit values were reduced.
tracks.why: 토템 배치/거리/보스전 안전성은 연습 가능하지만 3.29 최종 딜은 old PoB로 판단하면 안 된다.
do_not_assume: Kinetic Fusillade totem remains a safe starter

tracks.label: RF/화염 DoT 캠페인 루트
applies_to: Master T Ignite Slamentalist Act 2 RF swap
patch_hooks: No direct RF nerf in the collected 3.29 summary.
Pure Fire Spells generally gained lower mana costs and higher added-damage effectiveness.
tracks.why: 회복/저항/화염 노출/맵 진입 습관은 계속 중요하다. RF는 숫자보다 안정 루틴을 연습하는 가치가 크다.
do_not_assume: league mechanic safety without death-rate data

tracks.label: Scion/Reliquarian/Luminary 시작 루트
patch_hooks: Reliquarian notables were shuffled for 3.29.
Scion must be split into Ascendant, Reliquarian, and Luminary.
Luminary requires separate Mercenary state modeling.
User-supplied Luminary transcript adds link-skill, light-radius, unique-gear, and Hallowed Monarch hypotheses that still need official/GGPK verification.
tracks.why: 과거 Scion 연습은 조작감 정도만 도움 된다. 실제 3.29 빌드는 branch와 notables가 확인된 뒤 봐야 한다.
practice_focus: do not practice as a starter unless branch is known
wait for PoB and tree data
do_not_assume: link-skill shells work before node names, Mercenary skills, and Hallowed Monarch behavior are verified

category_matrix.purpose: 같은 스킬명이라도 self-cast, mine, totem, trigger, minion이면 3.29 영향이 다르다.

tracks.label: Self-cast Cold / Cold DoT
patch_hooks: Cold Snap, Creeping Frost, Vortex, Frostbolt, Ice Nova, Freezing Pulse, Winter Orb all received favorable cold-spell lines.
tracks.risk: Archmage versions are separate because Archmage support itself was nerfed.

tracks.label: Self-cast Lightning / Mana Spell
patch_hooks: Spark, Shock Nova, Ball Lightning, Lightning Conduit and several lightning spells changed cast time/damage and often gained 25% mana cost.
Archmage support was reduced from 10-16% to 8-14% unreserved maximum mana.
tracks.risk: The play pattern transfers, but old DPS and mana comfort do not.

tracks.label: Self-cast Fire / Ignite
patch_hooks: Pure fire spells generally have lower mana costs and higher added-damage effectiveness.
Flame Surge burning-ground contribution improved.
Emberwake/Replica Emberwake and Abberath's Horn received ignite-relevant changes.
candidate_examples: Explosive Arrow ignite variants as a separate ballista-affected group
tracks.risk: Ballista or Maw-specific mechanics still need separate recalculation.

tracks.label: Physical Spell / Crit Spell
patch_hooks: Shadow-themed Physical Spells have higher crit chances.
Bladefall and Blade Blast received direct improvements.
tracks.risk: Scion/Reliquarian versions are still 구경만 until branch PoBs exist.

tracks.label: Chaos DoT / Channeling
patch_hooks: Pact of Ghorr empowers DoT spells.
Pact of Lycia empowers self-cast channelling spells.
Occultist gains Unhallowed Rite for channelling spell ES recharge/damage/cost pressure.
tracks.risk: Affliction cost and live survivability are unknown.

tracks.label: Mine Delivery
patch_hooks: Mine supports and Charged Mines changed.
Eye of Winter crit improved, but mine supports still apply.
candidate_examples: Hexblast Mine as separate lower-priority lane
tracks.risk: Exact gem setup must be edited; Exsanguinate/Reap and Hexblast should not be merged.

tracks.label: Totem Delivery
patch_hooks: Spell Totem and Ballista Totem support penalties increased.
Hierophant totem damage and totem crit passive values were reduced.
tracks.risk: Practice is useful; old damage is not.

tracks.label: Non-Spectre Minions
patch_hooks: Non-Spectre minions no longer pause while attacking.
Dominating Blow, Zombies, SRS, Skeletons, and several Golems were explicitly highlighted.
tracks.risk: Carrion Golem needs exact current PoB; Spectres are excluded from this positive judgement.

tracks.label: Spectres
patch_hooks: Life of various monsters when used as Spectres was lowered.
tracks.risk: Species-specific life/survival must be revalidated before recommendation.

tracks.label: Trigger: CoC / CwC / Spellslinger
patch_hooks: Cast while Channelling improved trigger interval and less-damage penalty.
Volatile Dead of Confinement received larger explosion radius.
tracks.risk: CwC, CoC, CWS, and Spellslinger are separate engines; do not transfer buffs blindly.

tracks.label: Cast on Ward Break
patch_hooks: Cast on Ward Break cooldown recovery is capped at 400%.
what_to_practice: only inspect after updated specialist PoB

tracks.label: Bow Hit / Wander Hit
patch_hooks: Elemental Hit was nerfed.
Kinetic Blast and Kinetic Fusillade changed directly.
Reflect became mitigatable thorns but still matters for fast hits.
tracks.risk: Kinetic and Elemental Hit require exact variant checks.

tracks.label: Melee Strike/Slam
patch_hooks: Crystalfall supports self-used Slams.
Faster Attacks vendor access broadens early attack support access.
tracks.risk: 3.29 slam variants may diverge sharply around Crystalfall.

category_matrix.purpose: 3.29에서 같은 딜 빌드라도 방어·아이템 압박 때문에 추천성이 갈린다.

tracks.label: Armour/Life/Recovery
patch_hooks: Thorns reflected damage can be mitigated through Armour, Block, Resistances, etc.
tracks.why: Allflame/Atlas 위험도가 미확정일 때는 단단한 루틴 연습 가치가 높다.
tracks.check: death rate and recovery comfort in red maps after launch

tracks.label: Evasion/Suppression/Fast Mapper
patch_hooks: Thorns can be mitigated through Evasion/Block/Resistances.
Fast-hit builds must record thorns comfort.
tracks.why: 맵핑 손맛은 연습 가치가 있지만, death-rate 검증 전까지 추천 순위는 과하게 올리지 않는다.
tracks.check: rare thorns deaths, suppression cap, ailment avoidance

tracks.label: Mana Cost / Cost Efficiency
patch_hooks: Reduced cost sources became Cost Efficiency in many places.
Arcane Conservation and Contemplative Meditation clusters were added.
Many lightning spells gained 25% mana cost.
Several uniques changed from reduced cost to cost efficiency.
tracks.check: PoB cost, actual cast sustain, reservation setup

tracks.label: Socket Color / Gem Quality
patch_hooks: Gems can be socketed into any equipment socket regardless of color.
Matching gem/socket color grants +10% quality.
Chromatic Orbs are rarer, so colour matching is an optimization choice rather than a leveling gate.
tracks.why: 색이 안 맞아도 젬은 쓸 수 있다. 색을 맞추면 그 젬의 품질 효과가 올라가므로 메인 딜 젬, 핵심 보조, 지속시간/반경/투사체/쿨다운/마나/상태이상 품질이 강한 젬부터 가치가 생긴다.
tracks.check: main-link quality value, non-white socket cost, filter highlights for valuable colour matches

tracks.label: Core Unique Dependency
patch_hooks: Many uniques changed directly, including Maw, Rathpith, Void Battery, Shimmeron, Voidfletcher, and Ward-related supports.
tracks.why: 아이템 하나가 빌드 정체성인 경우 old PoB 재사용 위험이 크다.
tracks.check: exact item version, divine-update behavior, new drop vs existing item

tracks.label: Mercenary / Luminary State
patch_hooks: Mercenaries are core, but permanent multi-mercenary gearing is Luminary-specific.
Luminary link shells need active Mercenary, reserve Mercenary, link owner, link target, and gear states separated.
tracks.why: 플레이어 빌드와 동료 상태를 분리 모델링하기 전에는 추천으로 쓰면 안 된다.
tracks.check: active mercenary, reserve mercenaries, gear restrictions, survivability, link uptime, link death behavior, Hallowed Monarch item text

category_matrix.purpose: 카테고리별로 누구의 3.29 업데이트를 먼저 기다릴지 정한다.

tracks.label: 소환수
tracks.source_goal: SRS/Zombie/Dominating Blow/Golem은 빠르게 PoB 확보, Spectre는 species survival 검증.

tracks.label: 마인
priority_sources: Conner Converse as advanced theory cross-check
tracks.source_goal: Hexblast가 아니라 Exsanguinate/Reap Trickster 업데이트를 먼저 수집.

tracks.label: 캐스터/브랜드
tracks.source_goal: Archmage/cost-efficiency와 Inquisitor crit pathing을 최신 PoB로 확인.

tracks.label: 레인저/근접
tracks.source_goal: Elemental Hit/Kinetic nerf 축과 weapon-upgrade melee 축을 분리.

tracks.label: 실험/기발한 빌드
tracks.source_goal: 재미있는 상호작용은 모으되 beginner recommendation은 PoB/예산/방어가 확인될 때만.

reviews.label: 가능성 높음
patch_hooks: All Non-Spectre Minions no longer pause while attacking.
Dominating Blow, Raised Zombies, Summoned Raging Spirits, and Summoned Skeletons are explicitly called out as significant DPS beneficiaries.
Absolution cast time improved, which helps several minion campaign routes.
reviews.why: The patch directly improves several minion engines and the older corpus already has SRS/minion leveling patterns.
caveats: Still needs 3.29 PoB for final support links and minion AI behavior.
Do not import Spectre survivability assumptions into this family.
next_checks: Collect Ghazzy/Tori/Dconnic 3.29 minion PoBs after launch.
Add Dominating Blow Guardian staged PoB if a current creator guide appears.

reviews.label: 위험 신호
patch_hooks: 3.29 lowers the life of various monsters when used as Spectres.
Originator-Influenced Monsters, Robot Monsters, and other high-life Spectre sources are named in the patch notes.
reviews.why: You can practice minion control and gearing, but old Wretched Defiler/Spectre tankiness cannot be trusted.
caveats: Damage may remain usable, but Spectre survival and AG/support package pressure must be revalidated.
Do not use as a blind first starter before creator updates.
next_checks: Check Dconnic/Tori/Ghazzy 3.29 Spectre updates.
Record Spectre species and life/survival separately from generic minion notes.

reviews.label: 연습해도 됨
patch_hooks: Non-Spectre minion attack behavior improved broadly.
Stone, Ice, Flame, Chaos and Lightning Golems are explicitly listed; Carrion Golem is not explicitly listed.
Absolution cast time improved for campaign transition routes.
reviews.why: The staged 3.28 Necromancer PoB is strong practice material, but 3.29 does not explicitly confirm Carrion Golem as one of the biggest winners.
caveats: Tori-sensei's exact current-season Poison Carrion Golem PoB is still a separate source target.
Carrion-specific DPS needs PoB or live validation.
next_checks: Retry Tori-sensei current-season PoB hunt.
Compare 3.28 staged Necro PoB against first 3.29 golem guides.

reviews.label: 가능성 높음
patch_hooks: Cold Snap gains freeze chance and higher critical strike chance.
Creeping Frost gains higher critical strike chance.
Vortex gains faster cast time, higher critical strike chance, freeze chance, and lower mana cost.
reviews.why: Master T's Righteous Cold PoB and older Cold DoT routes line up with multiple favorable cold spell changes.
caveats: Master T Righteous Cold is a transition/endgame build, not a clean campaign starter by itself.
Cold DoT final damage still needs 3.29 PoB because spell scaling and supports changed broadly.
next_checks: Collect current Cold DoT or Righteous Cold 3.29 PoB.
Separate campaign route from high-budget autobomber swap.

reviews.label: 손봐야 가능
patch_hooks: Archmage added lightning damage is reduced to 8-14% of unreserved maximum mana from 10-16%.
Ice Nova of Frostbolts gains freeze chance and higher critical strike chance.
Spark, Shock Nova, and Ball Lightning have cast time or damage changes but also higher mana costs.
reviews.why: The play pattern is still worth practicing, but old mana-stack numbers are not reliable.
caveats: Hierophant and mana gear may need tree/gear retuning around cost efficiency and reservation.
Do not assume 3.28 Archmage DPS survives unchanged.
next_checks: Run updated PoB once 3.29 support lands.
Check early mana cost comfort before recommending to new players.

reviews.label: 가능성 높음
patch_hooks: No direct Righteous Fire nerf appears in the collected 3.29 summary.
Socket color changes lower gem access friction but change optimization around matching socket colors.
reviews.why: RF fundamentals and campaign discipline remain strong practice material.
caveats: Atlas and Allflame encounter danger still need live measurement.
Old off-color/socket advice must be rewritten for 3.29.
next_checks: Check Pohx/creator 3.29 RF route updates.
Refresh filter and socket-color guidance.

reviews.label: 연습해도 됨
patch_hooks: Crystalfall is a new support for self-used Slam skills and cannot support triggered or non-player-used skills.
No direct Boneshatter nerf appears in the collected 3.29 summary.
reviews.why: Melee leveling, weapon upgrade cadence, armour/recovery habits, and slam positioning are useful to practice even if final 3.29 slam tech changes.
caveats: Crystalfall may create new slam variants but should not be assumed mandatory.
Bleed and weapon craft economy need launch-week validation.
next_checks: Collect 3.29 slam creator PoBs.
Compare old Boneshatter trauma setup against 3.29 defenses and map thorns.

reviews.label: 연습해도 됨
patch_hooks: Crystalfall creates a new self-used slam support lane.
Emberwake and Replica Emberwake receive ignite-related improvements.
Master T staged PoB already covers campaign into Sunder ignite Elementalist.
reviews.why: This is good practice for a Witch/Elementalist melee-ignite transition, but exact 3.29 setup may change around new supports and ignite item choices.
caveats: Do not generalize this into Duelist melee.
Needs a current 3.29 PoB before beginner recommendation.
next_checks: Watch Master T updates after 3.29 launch.
Check whether Crystalfall is used or skipped in the final build.

reviews.label: 연습해도 됨
patch_hooks: Reflect map modifiers are reworked into rare-monster thorns and can be mitigated by standard defenses.
No direct Lightning Strike or Frost Blades nerf appears in the collected 3.29 summary.
reviews.why: Attack movement, mark/accuracy habits, and weapon upgrade practice remain useful.
caveats: Thorns and new encounter damage need live comfort checks.
Reliquarian Lightning Strike is separate from normal Slayer/Champion/Warden-style practice.
next_checks: Check 3.29 attack mapper creator PoBs.
Record thorns deaths for fast-hit attack builds.

reviews.label: 가능성 높음
patch_hooks: No direct Toxic Rain or Poisonous Concoction nerf appears in the collected 3.29 summary.
Ballista Totem support nerf affects ballista-assisted poison/chaos variants more than self-used routes.
reviews.why: Pathfinder chaos/poison fundamentals look like good practice material, especially for SSF-style gearing.
caveats: Ballista supplement setups need recalculation.
Launch economy may change flask/weapon/cluster availability.
next_checks: Separate self-cast/self-attack Pathfinder from ballista variants.
Collect current Kankar/anime_princess/Pathfinder PoBs if available.

reviews.label: 손봐야 가능
patch_hooks: Elemental Hit loses 17% added fire/cold/lightning damage at all gem levels, while Elemental Hit of the Spectrum is not affected.
Ballista Totem support now has a larger less-damage penalty.
reviews.why: Bow/ballista mechanics are still useful, but old DPS expectations are suspect.
caveats: Do not treat generic Elemental Hit and Elemental Hit of the Spectrum as the same build.
Explosive Arrow and poison ballista variants need support-link recalculation.
next_checks: Identify exact Elemental Hit variant in each PoB.
Re-run ballista DPS with 3.29 support values.

reviews.label: 위험 신호
patch_hooks: Kinetic Blast Arcane Might and area damage values changed unfavorably.
Kinetic Fusillade attack speed drops sharply and mana cost increases.
Totem support and Hierophant totem scaling also changed.
reviews.why: The old wander/totem numbers are too exposed to direct 3.29 changes.
caveats: Basic wander movement practice is fine, but do not plan league start around old PoBs.
Reliquarian wander shells need current notables.
next_checks: Wait for Fubgun/Palsteron/Kinetic specialist updates.
Verify whether Kinetic Fusillade remains playable after support and skill changes stack.

reviews.label: 연습해도 됨
patch_hooks: Blastchain Mine and High-Impact Mine have larger less-damage penalties and higher cost multipliers.
Charged Mines loses some throw-speed and crit scaling and has a higher cost multiplier.
Barrage support changes may affect projectile mine variants.
reviews.why: Mine preload, campaign swap timing, and Pyroclast into Exsang/Reap muscle memory are worth practicing, but 3.29 damage/cost must be edited.
caveats: This is not Hexblast-first guidance; Exsanguinate/Reap Trickster remains the tracked mine lane.
Throw speed, mana, and reservation comfort need retest.
next_checks: Watch Cptn Garbage/FearlessDumb0/Jorgen for updated 3.29 links.
Recalculate early-map swap timing after mine support changes.

reviews.label: 위험 신호
patch_hooks: Hexblast has a cooldown in the current patch line; 3.29 lowers it to 1 second but does not restore old high-frequency mine behaviour.
Mine supports and Charged Mines changed.
The project scope currently prioritizes Exsanguinate/Reap Miner over generic Hexblast mines.
reviews.why: Old Hexblast Mine PoBs are not safe to carry forward as recommendations. Treat this as watchlist-only until a 3.29 specialist PoB proves curse application, cooldown, mana, and boss/mapping cadence.
caveats: Bossing may survive differently from mapping, but it is not a default starter recommendation.
Needs current curse application, cooldown, mine support, and mana PoB confirmation.
next_checks: Collect 3.29 Hexblast specialist PoBs only as watchlist evidence after Exsang Miner lane is refreshed.
Do not merge Hexblast and Exsang mining in UI recommendations.

reviews.label: 손봐야 가능
patch_hooks: Spell Totem support now has a larger less-damage penalty.
Ritual of Awakening drops from 5% to 3% more damage per summoned totem.
Totem mastery and Shaman's Dominion critical values were reduced.
Holy Flame Totem itself gains a small critical strike chance buff.
reviews.why: Totem positioning and campaign safety are still useful to practice, but old Hierophant totem PoBs need direct edits.
caveats: Do not recommend Kinetic Fusillade Totem from old numbers.
Shockwave/Storm Burst/Holy Flame need separate recalculation.
next_checks: Check Tatiantel2/Palsteron/POEGuy-style updates.
Re-run totem PoBs with 3.29 support and ascendancy values.

reviews.label: 연습해도 됨
patch_hooks: Inquisitor spell crit pathing changed: old Mystical Infusion behavior moved behind a new Instruments of Justice notable.
Replica Tukohama's Fortress brand critical strike chance per Brand improved.
reviews.why: Brand positioning, recall rhythm, and Sanctum-style practice transfer, but exact Inquisitor tree and crit assumptions need update.
caveats: ZeeBoub guide material remains valuable, but 3.29 tree pathing must be checked.
Do not assume old Inquisitor crit setup is identical.
next_checks: Refresh ZeeBoub/Penance Brand PoBs.
Check whether Instruments of Justice changes tree pathing cost.

reviews.label: 가능성 높음
patch_hooks: Bladefall and Blade Blast receive damage, area, or critical strike improvements.
Shadow-themed physical spells generally receive higher critical strike chances.
3.29 introduces Reap of Butchery as a new watch target.
reviews.why: Physical spell fundamentals look worth revisiting in 3.29.
caveats: Old Reap PoBs may not represent new Reap of Butchery.
Reliquarian variants require current notables.
next_checks: Collect new physical spell PoBs after PoB updates.
Separate Assassin/Inquisitor/Scion branch assumptions.

reviews.label: 연습해도 됨
patch_hooks: Volatile Dead of Confinement gains larger explosion radius.
Cast while Channelling support improves trigger interval and less-damage penalty, but that is not the same as CoC or Spellslinger.
